name: adya-pustaka-bhandara-monorepo
description: Adya Pustaka Bhandara & Adya Jyothirvijnana Samshodhana Kendra MERN Application

scripts.dev: node --input-type=module -e "import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'; const s = spawn('npm --prefix server run dev', { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const c = spawn('npm --prefix client run dev', { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const stop = () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(0); }; process.on('SIGINT', stop); process.on('SIGTERM', stop);"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
